blurb: Guests ride the restored river boat Rose Lummis on Sodus Bay for 90-minute or two-hour cruises. Tours include eco-tours with wildlife education, sightseeing, and themed evening cruises with live music or tastings. Tours depart from Oak Park Marina in North Rose, NY, and food and drinks can be purchased and brought aboard.
